Hi Alex —

Great to speak this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Primary use case: near-real-time personalization for patient outreach (low-latency scoring + privacy controls).
- Data types: de-identified patient metadata + hashed identifiers; no PII in prompts based on current flow.
- Success metrics: 95th percentile inference latency < 200ms for 512-token requests; cost target ~ $0.003/token for production batch.
- Constraints: SOC2 evidence required, audit logs retention for 1 year, and procurement needs T&Cs review.

Suggested next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (1h) with your platform/engineering + our SE to validate KV caching, token mix, and network egress.
2) Security intake: security questionnaire + SOC2 artifact handoff so your compliance team can sign off.
3) Procurement intro to align on contracting timeline and purchase options.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Wed Sep 1, 10:00–11:00 PDT
- Thu Sep 2, 08:00–09:00 PDT

I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) to help outline owners and deliverables. Can you confirm: 1) which of the two windows works, and 2) the security and procurement POC(s) we should loop in?

Thanks — happy to be flexible on time.

Best,

Thanks for the loop, Aditya.

Wed Sep 1, 10:00–11:00 PDT is confirmed on our side. Attaching our security questionnaire for intake: acme_security_questionnaire.pdf.

For SOC2 evidence we typically request:
- SOC2 Type II report (most recent)
- List of subservice organizations (if any)
- Details on encryption at rest/in transit and key management (KMS/HSM)
- Audit log retention and export formats (we prefer JSON/CSV exports)

A live demo of the audit log export is ideal but not required for initial review — a one-page export sample will suffice to start.

Looking forward to the session.

— Maya
